description: Use when you need a multi-chain wallet balance, a wallet portfolio or wallet transaction history on Ethereum, Base or Solana. Do not use for uSD values, NFTs, DeFi positions, long-tail tokens or chains beyond Ethereum, Base and Solana. Returns JSON with a multi-chain wallet balance and transaction history: native and major-token balances on Ethereum, Base or Solana plus the latest transfers, without airdrop spam for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 3000 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.005 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

address.description: Wallet address: 0x... for Ethereum and Base, or a Solana address, e.g. 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045

chains.description: Chains to read (ethereum and base for a 0x address, solana for a Solana address, when omitted), e.g. ["base"]

historyLimit.description: Latest transfers to return per chain, 0 to 25 (10 when omitted), e.g. 5

name: blackwood_wallet_portfolio
title: Wallet portfolio and history
